item.title: Wed Oct 7 · MBA 201A Lecture 13: Why the Winner Overpaid
item.description:
Meets 2:00pm, N370 Chou Hall.
Logistics (course feedback due Wed 9am; PP6 attestation Sun; Axe class contribution survey Mon Oct 12; Group AI Memo Oct 17; last Example in the Wild the week after; final Fri Oct 16). Winner's curse from Surowiecki (Gulf oil leases, A-Rod sealed bidding vs the open Clinton memoir auction; shade your bid). Fowlie on California wildfire insurance: coarse zip-code pricers win the risky homes, raise prices or exit; fix by spreading granular risk information. Principal-agent conditions; adverse selection (hidden type, lemons unraveling, maternity plan) vs moral hazard (hidden action, copays, cost-plus builder); fixes via information, incentives, signaling. Hold up named but not covered. Ties back to Lecture 1's Force, Trap, Edge list.
